description: This file defines a Bootstrap tooltip plugin, including the Tooltip class, its methods, and jQuery plugin registration. It manages tooltip display logic, positioning, and content.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class managing tooltip behavior, including show, hide, position, and content management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tooltip with type, element, and options.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges default options with user options and data attributes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focus events to show tooltip with delay.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or blur events to hide tooltip with delay.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip, positions it based on placement, and applies animation if enabled.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and removes the tooltip, with optional transition animation.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content based on the title.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip title from data attributes or options.
